blocker.name: UnsupportedI80386
blocker.message: VM86 IRET is outside the bounded profile

audit: Original-386 INT null new SS uses #GP; CALL null new SS uses #TS.
Mixed gate width, stack address size, copied parameters and outer discard have independent witnesses.
Execute-only far pointer reads fault before bus access.
I/O bitmap base at/above TSS limit is absent; a later permission byte at the inclusive limit remains addressable.
Denied I/O reference evidence requires owned #GP handler and restart frame, never generic host abort.
Conforming interrupt results are independently graded; pinned PCjs target-RPL stack-switch difference is explicit.
inheritedAcceptance: 286 DOS2 boot/write/fresh-read source dependencies unchanged; earlier source-bound receipt remains authoritative.
